rationale: First live calibration of the §10.5 materiality classifier against a human-reviewed gold set — 32 spans: 12 out-of-ledger seed escapes (material claims deliberately absent from the ledger) plus 20 real-prose negatives (13 labelled non-material). Judge: Groq-hosted llama-3.3-70b-versatile, a non-drafter model over the OpenAI-compatible transport, independent of the Claude drafter. Result: escape-recall 100% (12/12 out-of-ledger material claims caught — the dangerous 'fabricates without a ledger record' miss mode is clean) and precision 100% (0 false alarms over 13 labelled negatives; gap-detection-recall 1.0). The single disagreement is rneg-17 — the checkable fact 'dual habilitation' embedded in a rhetorical clause the judge read as framing (a missed embedded claim, the safe under-flag direction, not a missed escape). Both operator bars cleared (precision 1.0 ≥ 0.85; escape-recall 1.0 ≥ 0.80) and the labels are human-attested, so graduation_for returns gating_permitted. It is recorded as PERMITTED but NOT promoted: N=25 effective (12 seeds + 13 labelled negatives) is a thin basis, this is a single judge on a single run, and the reviewer logged 0 overrides of the AI-suggested pre-fill (agreement rather than independent divergence). E3 therefore stays advisory in practice until the set is enlarged and/or a second independent judge corroborates — consistent with the ticket's 'Done = a graduation decision recorded, not necessarily promotion.'
constitutional_check: E3.1 evaluates no gate (§17.6.2) and blocks no run — advisory by construction (harness/HARNESS.md); the 138 predicates + byte-equal checks remain the only blocking gates. Judge verdicts are typed Inferred (§12.2). Grader/generator independence upheld: a non-drafter model (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) over the OpenAI-compatible transport, distinct from the Claude drafter, with the claude_cli transport rejected. Gold labels are human ground truth (E1.5 independence rule); no project fact fabricated (§13.3) — the run judges existing spans against human labels and authors nothing. The decision is keyed to the exact judge pin (llama-3.3-70b-versatile@groq-llama-3.3-70b@2026-08-03); a repin re-opens advisory. Reads a harness-owned gold sheet; writes only harness-owned artifacts and this decision log (§9). No CLAUDE.md amendment required.
